job.title: Senior Product Owner PIM / Product Information Management (alle Geschlechter)

tailoring.headline: Senior Product Owner – PIM & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | 5+ yrs E-Commerce Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with proven success designing and operating PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines, integrating ERP and MDM systems, and translating business requirements into functional specifications. Skilled in stakeholder management, agile product ownership, and AI-assisted analysis, ensuring high-quality, scalable e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Owner PIM / Product Information Management
cover_en.hook: I am excited about OBI’s ambition to strengthen its digital product catalogue and deliver seamless customer experiences. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and governed PIM integrations that directly support retail growth. My techno-functional background equips me to bridge business vision and technical execution in this role.

bullets.label: PIM Integration
bullets.text: Designed and implemented PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring accurate product information across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business and technical teams to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into reliable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Product Ownership
bullets.text: Led backlog grooming, sprint planning and acceptance testing within Scrum teams, delivering API migrations and enhancements that improved system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: API & Data Migration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST services and executed API migration projects, streamlining product data flows between ERP, MDM and the storefront.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to OBI.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Product Owner PIM / Product Information Management
cover_de.hook: Die digitale Weiterentwicklung von OBI begeistert mich – insbesondere die Optimierung des Produktinformationsmanagements für ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich PIM-Integrationen erfolgreich realisiert. Meine techno-funktionale Expertise verbindet Geschäftsanforderungen und technische Umsetzung optimal.

bullets.label: PIM-Integration
bullets.text: Konzipierte und implementierte PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub, um konsistente Produktinformationen über globale E-Commerce-Kanäle sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Analysierte gemeinsam mit internationalen Fach- und Technik-Teams Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in zuverlässige SAP-Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: Agile Produktverantwortung
bullets.text: Leitete Backlog-Pflege, Sprint-Planung und Abnahmetests in Scrum-Teams und lieferte API-Migrations- und Optimierungsprojekte, die Systemstabilität und Datenkonsistenz verbesserten.

bullets.label: API- und Datenmigration
bullets.text: Entwickelte und veröffentlichte OCC-REST-Services und führte API-Migrationsprojekte durch, um Produktdatenflüsse zwischen ERP, MDM und Front-End zu optimieren.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist. Ein Einstieg ab dem 16.12.2026 ist möglich. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu OBI zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: OBI is Germany’s leading DIY retailer, investing heavily in digital transformation to offer customers a unified, data-driven shopping experience. The company’s focus on modernizing its product catalogue aligns perfectly with my proven track record of building robust PIM integrations and driving agile product ownership within SAP Commerce Cloud environments. I am eager to apply my expertise to help OBI accelerate its e-commerce growth and deliver consistent, high-quality product information across all channels.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help OBI shape a best-in-class digital catalogue by leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud and PIM integration experience to deliver seamless, data-driven customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of PIM integration experience. I’m very interested in OBI’s Senior Product Owner role and would love to discuss how I can add value to your digital transformation.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Product Owner PIM / Product Information Management
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Product Owner PIM position at OBI. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and a strong background in PIM integration and agile product ownership, I am confident I can contribute to your digital growth.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.
